import numpy as np
from scipy import stats

mu, sigma = 50, 10

pdf_55 = stats.norm.pdf(55, loc=mu, scale=sigma)

cdf_55 = stats.norm.cdf(55, loc=mu, scale=sigma)

prob_1std = stats.norm.cdf(60, loc=mu, scale=sigma) - stats.norm.cdf(40, loc=mu, scale=sigma)

percentile_95 = stats.norm.ppf(0.95, loc=mu, scale=sigma)

n_bin, p_bin = 100, 0.3

prob_exact_30 = stats.binom.pmf(30, n_bin, p_bin)

cdf_30 = stats.binom.cdf(30, n_bin, p_bin)

lambda_poisson = 5

poisson_prob_3 = stats.poisson.pmf(3, lambda_poisson)

poisson_prob_ge_8 = 1 - stats.poisson.cdf(7, lambda_poisson)

print(f"Normal PDF at 55: {pdf_55:.4f}")
print(f"Normal CDF at 55: {cdf_55:.4f}")
print(f"P(40 < X < 60): {prob_1std:.4f}")
print(f"95th percentile: {percentile_95:.4f}")
print(f"Binomial P(X=30): {prob_exact_30:.4f}")
print(f"Binomial P(X<=30): {cdf_30:.4f}")
print(f"Poisson P(X=3): {poisson_prob_3:.4f}")
print(f"Poisson P(X>=8): {poisson_prob_ge_8:.4f}")
